name: Summon Dinosaur

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Summon an Ankylosaur, Triceratops, or Tyrannosaur spirit into a visible empty space. It acts just after you on your Initiative, follows free verbal commands, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 HP or spell end. Slot level scales the source Dinosaur Spirit stat block; statistics and companion actions require manual resolution.
